edit.description: `EmitOwnedEntry::path` (4251) is a `PathBuf` holding a harness-relative spelling — type it `HarnessRelativePath`. `emit_owned_targets_from_doc` (4276) then drops the `PathBuf::from(&*source_path)` downgrade and the comment re-asserting the form the row column's own type already carries (4287-4290), and the manifest branch spells once at its door, `HarnessRelativePath::new(to_canonical_spelling(&manifest_path))` (4315-4325). `collected` (4311) becomes a `BTreeSet<HarnessRelativePath>` off `target.path.clone()`, losing its re-spell.

`GuardedManifest::path` (1617) takes the same type. `path_matches` (1531) then compares typed candidates against the relativized `file_path` directly — its `to_canonical_spelling(candidate)` (1539) goes, and with it the doc sentence that explains the re-spell; its two callers are `matched_projection` (1568, over `EmitOwnedEntry::path`) and `manifest_write_findings` (1859, over `GuardedManifest::path`), each passing one candidate through `std::iter::once`. `projection_owner_line` (1583), `unreconstructable_manifest_finding` (1792) and `unparseable_manifest_finding` (1818) print the field rather than re-spelling it. `GuardedLocus::pattern` is deliberately NOT in scope: a locus glob is not a source path, and the type is the lock's source-path vocabulary (src/path.rs:138).

`manifest_path` (885) returns `Option<HarnessRelativePath>`, spelling `drift::join_locus`'s host-separated `PathBuf` once at this one door (`join_locus` itself keeps returning `PathBuf` — it also composes glob patterns, at 864 and src/read.rs:735, which the type does not claim). `container_kinds` (782) keys its `BTreeMap` by the same type so the `containers.get(&path)` lookups in `guarded_manifests` (732, 755) stay one type on both sides.

The `path_to_id` map (2482) keys off `entry.path.to_string_lossy().to_string()` — a lossy conversion that only reads right because the `EmitOwnedEntry` path was already canonical. With the field typed it keys off the path's own spelling, and the comment loses the repo-relative hedge.

The emit-owned manifest dedupe case compares `target.path == Path::new(".claude/settings.json")` (2411); the retyped field makes that a string compare. The file's guard cases (projection refusal owner line, manifest write findings) must stay byte-identical — the entry is behavior-neutral.

`HarnessRelativePath`'s doc (138-142) lists the carriers that share the form — `Projection`, `RollupEntry`, `RawLockRow`, `ProvenanceRow`, `EmitOwnedEntry` — and closes "so a path fact's root is its type, not its doc comment". `EmitOwnedEntry` becomes true of that list here; `Projection` is still a `PathBuf` until the sibling entry, and the two member-site carriers 9739284c typed (`LayoutMemberSite`, `LocusMemberSite`) are missing from it. Restate the list as what holds at this commit, naming the one carrier the close does not yet cover. No code change in this file.

summary: The guard's two path candidates — `EmitOwnedEntry::path` and `GuardedManifest::path` — are `PathBuf`s whose harness-relative form every consumer re-spells by hand.

per.section: A shared concept is one type

tests.asserts: the guard's projection and manifest bindings are unchanged — same findings, same owner line, same dedupe verdict — over typed candidates
the `InstructionsLoaded` path-to-id normalization (2155-2244) still folds a repo-relative record path onto its member id

acceptance: `cargo test` green with no snapshot moves, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, and a census showing no `to_canonical_spelling` call remains over either carrier (`rg 'to_canonical_spelling' src/install.rs src/main.rs` leaves only the locus-pattern sites).
notes: Same thread as 7f04c6a0/9739284c. `HarnessRelativePath`'s doc (src/path.rs:141) already names `EmitOwnedEntry` a carrier; the field is a `PathBuf`. Behavior-neutral on every reachable input — each consumer already spells — so the pin is the type at compile time, not a red-first case: verify that rather than assert it. The emit-side carriers are serialized behind this as EMIT-SIDE-PATHS-CARRY-THE-HARNESS-RELATIVE-TYPE; both entries edit src/drift.rs and src/path.rs. scoped at 7e9a5a03
